ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 40:60 ratio of low-intensity black to high-intensity white/cream pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the central-to-outer areas of both lobes. These are bounded by low-intensity black margins. Notable high-contrast black mottling and circular spots are dispersed throughout the white regions, particularly on the left lobe. A thick, dark horizontal band intersects the high-intensity region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a central convergence point located at the mid-axial line of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge. The right lobe exhibits several deep, low-amplitude concave indentations near the distal tip, contrasting with the more uniform micro-serrations on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex sweep trajectory on the distal outer edges, curving significantly upward and outward towards the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, low-intensity pixel clusters (approximately 5-8 distinct points) are visible within the high-intensity white field of the left lobe, likely corresponding to barnacle attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent, near-horizontal linear dark pixel disruption is visible across the lower half of the right lobe, extending approximately one-third the width of the lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular trauma-related indentations on the trailing edge of the right lobe tip and a significant horizontal rake mark across the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique asymmetrical pigmentation pattern with a dominant dark horizontal streak on the right lobe and dense spotting on the left lobe.
